APPROVED_SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENT_CONT.objective: Complete the inherited Go route control plane under /app/routecp as a fleet-wide desired-state routing and policy reconciliation system.
material_requirements: canonical IPv4/IPv6 route and policy-rule identities with valid rule/table dependencies
revision-fenced preview/apply/rollback with idempotent retries and no partial publication
failure-safe per-node recovery across restart without overwriting newer state
fresh owned drift reconciliation that preserves unowned routing objects and management reachability
fleet rollout isolation for failed canaries/offline nodes and no redundant reapply for nodes already at target
idempotent Ansible deployment with host-specific protected routing taking precedence over defaults
dashboard mutations bound to the exact preview revision so concurrent operator changes are not silently overwritten
preserve existing public Go API/runtime and fleet/configuration interfaces
all routing mutations remain inside the supplied isolated deterministic model and never alter the benchmark host network

structure: state the approved engineering objective first
preserve exact public contracts and hard safety/state constraints
reference solver-visible technical contracts instead of reproducing hidden verifier rows
avoid: task details copied from unrelated calibration domains
